alt: The Scroll of Availability: a week-long grid with green, yellow and red cells, and brown shading on the evenings when other people are free.
caption: Everyone marks when they are free: green is available, yellow is maybe, red is not available. The shading shows when others are free.

alt: A ranked list of the three best times, each with the number of people free, a vote count, a Cast Your Vote button and a Decree the Session button.
caption: The best times are ranked and put to a vote. The organizer can decree the winner.

alt: A list of sessions marked collecting, scheduled, automatic and held, with a note saying one older session is not shown and one was called off.
caption: Past, upcoming and automatically scheduled sessions. Older ones are kept but not listed.

alt: The campaign settings: how often the group gathers, session length, minimum free players, reminder times and a Discord event option.
caption: Settings: how often the group meets, session length, how many must be free, reminders, and a Discord event for each session.

alt: The home page in the Dungeons and Dragons theme, listing four groups with the person's role in each.
caption: The home page: your groups and your role in each, in the Dungeons & Dragons theme.

alt: The same availability grid in the plain theme, with a white page, blue accents and the same green, yellow and red cells.
caption: The same grid in the plain theme, for groups that are not playing a game.

alt: The home page in the plain theme, where the roles read Group manager and Member.
caption: The plain theme also changes the wording: Group manager and Member instead of Dungeon Master and Player.

alt: Three phone screens side by side: the home page, the availability grid and the vote, all laid out for a narrow screen.
caption: It works on phones.

alt: A reminder direct message from the bot asking "Will you be there?", with I'm in and Can't make it buttons.
caption: No more reminding your players by hand: the bot sends each one a reminder with I'm in and Can't make it buttons.

alt: Two bot messages in a Discord channel: the session is decreed with the next one scheduled automatically, followed by a reminder that mentions the party.
caption: Automated announcements and reminders go out to your entire party, and the next session is scheduled for you.

alt: A Discord event created by the bot, showing its date and time, a link to the group, and the series of weekly events that follow.
caption: Prefer Discord's own tools? The bot creates the event for you and repeats it every week.

alt: The bot's vote message in a Discord channel, listing three ranked times with Vote buttons and a Decree the session button.
caption: No more arguing over dates: vote for the time that works for you and the bot handles the rest.
